<item><title>Courting the Light of the Beloved: A Telling of the Mystical Love Story Layla & Majnun</title><category>Event</category><pubDate>Fri, 25 Sep 2026 16:34:23 +0000</pubDate><link>https://storyparloravl.com/calendar/courting-the-light-of-the-beloved</link><guid isPermaLink="false">61900a9512461b21aae31923:61906d9e8c26cf03eb678719:6ab6a08743fa3d355999b284</guid><description><p>OFF SITE EVENT! | Join us at Mars Landing Art Gallery for this contemporary telling of Layla &amp; Majnun, the classic Sufi folktale popularized by Nizami, the great 12th-century Persian epic poet. This tale is like Romeo &amp; Juliet meets the enchanted, animist heart of the ancestral desert soul. It is a return to the Garden of Eden, to the divine power of Eros.
